name: Everscale
classificationNote: Classified by keyword rules from the SlowMist label and description.
rootCause: Blockchain network Everscale said that a large number of EVER tokens have been stolen and they are working closely with exchanges where EVER is listed in order to stop any further outflow of tokens. To halt the actions of those responsible, they have temporarily disconnected Octus Bridge.
